verdict.rationale: Mastra documents storage-backed suspend/resume that lets workflows/agents pause indefinitely and resume later (mastra-gh-4, mastra-docs-12), and memory persists thread state across interactions (mastra-docs-4/17), which supports native durability across restarts. However there is no evidence of durable-execution integrations (e.g., Temporal, Inngest) or explicit guarantees about surviving deploys/process restarts beyond the storage layer, and no independent corroboration of this durability in production. Missing for 10: explicit durable-execution integration support, documented deploy/restart resilience testing, independent hands-on verification.
